name: solemate
description: SoleMate: custom shoes from a 3D foot scan (monorepo root)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.setup: npm run setup:api && npm run setup:web
scripts.setup:api: cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
